meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 将 Linear 工单评论转为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队用 Linear 管理任务并希望直接在聊天中跟进评论。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Linear for task management and wants to follow up comments in chat.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会自动监听并回复指定 Linear 团队中所有 issue 的评论，无需 @ 提及。每个 issue 的评论线程会作为一个独立对话被处理。
howto.when: 当指定 Linear 团队中任意 issue 有新评论时触发。

say.text: 分析这个 bug 的根因是什么？
say.note: Claude 会在该评论下自动回复。

say.text: 这个 issue 的下一步行动有哪些？
帮我总结当前线程的讨论要点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically monitors and replies to all issue comments in the specified Linear team, without needing @-mentions. Each issue's comment thread becomes a separate conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a new comment is made on any issue in the specified Linear team.

say_en.text: What is the root cause of this bug?
say_en.note: Claude will reply in the comment thread.

say_en.text: What are the next steps for this issue?
Summarize the key points of this thread.
